Reliance GDR fell more than 4% in London on Jul 19 after Q1 results (Indian price discovery pending)

Coalition budgets err conservative; expect satisfaction-of-everyone rather than big-bang reform.

After the first Fed cut, leadership rotates from defensives (IT/FMCG/pharma) to cyclicals (banks).

events.claim: Union Budget Feb 1, 2025: no income tax up to ₹12 lakh via a ₹60,000 rebate, but any capital-gains income disqualifies the rebate
FIIs sold ~1,800 crore even on budget Saturday, Feb 1, 2025

lessons: Headline exemptions can carry disqualifying fine print - capital-gains income voided the flagship rebate.
Policy support arrives in sequence (RBI liquidity → Budget → RBI policy); price the pipeline, not the single event.
No bad news is already good news - but a neutral budget with bearish positioning still pressures the index.
